count.description: Number of ICMP packets to send per host.

interval.description: Interval between sending packets in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout for receiving replies in seconds.

source_address.description: Source IP address or hostname to use.

hosts_file.description: Filename containing list of hosts to ping. Use '-' for stdin.

csv_output.description: Filename to write CSV measurements to.

qos.description: Quality of Service setting (e.g., be, ef, va, af13, cs0).

mark.description: Linux packet mark for iptables. Set to -1 to disable.

drop_limit.description: Exit non-zero if drop rate exceeds this percent. Set to -1 to disable.

hosts.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses to ping. Only used if hosts_file is empty.
